sourceDigestNormalization: UTF-8 source bytes with CRLF normalized to LF
coverage: Authenticated explicit original/page checks, no file scan in repeated progress polling; original hashes are streamed and images have byte/pixel budgets.
Readable legacy PNG baselines carry legacy_observed; existing digests are never rebased after a mismatch. Embedded pages retain their bytes in the source record with separate digests.

Source text, structure, updatedAt and selection version remain unchanged by file checks. Current acknowledgment replay preserves checkedAt; expired keys cannot re-execute a check. Latest expired-key assertion is SQLite-only; the earlier PostgreSQL run covered immediate replay.
Missing/mismatch/unknown paths and Windows directory junctions remain untouched. Changed embedded bytes and malformed images cannot be downloaded as verified.
A second real store revokes the guardian binding while verification holds an open file; the stale request cannot persist its check or digests.
Real persistent processing repairs a missing and a damaged page. The worker verifies the original again at execution, rejecting bytes changed after the last check.
Native SQLite and pg_dump/pg_restore backups to empty roots retain actual newly recorded image files, embedded bytes and check records; application restart verifies them.

Both material-course and original PDF workbench use the same check UI. Browser tests cover lost acknowledgment/replay, keyboard activation, real missing-page regeneration, reload recovery, missing-original upload anchor and explicit corrupted-original limitation.
Desktop/tablet/phone geometry checks and inspected desktop/phone/workbench images; this is not a reference-product pixel-parity claim.
